title: CHAPTER 025 - Runtime-aware final handover to v3.6
description: Complete automated runtime-aware handover. It identifies the actual runner process executing this task by PID instead of assuming a v3.5 filename. It verifies the local v3.6 candidate hash and syntax, backs up runner/state/log files, determines whether the current process is already v3.6, and either validates the already-complete handover or arms a delayed helper bound to the actual current runner PID. After task 025 finalizes in state, the helper starts v3.6, verifies it is alive, then retires only the captured current runner process. No manual PowerShell required.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $bk=$root+'/backups/025/'+$stamp; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk|Out-Null; foreach($name in @('3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1','3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1','3en-agent-runner-v3.ps1','3en-agent.state.json','3en-agent.log','switch-to-v36-025.ps1')){$src=$root+'/'+$name;if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $src){Copy-Item -LiteralPath $src -Destination ($bk+'/'+$name) -Force}}; Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_025_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $v36=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; $helper=$root+'/switch-to-v36-025.ps1'; $expected='57233841FF0F7F6BF78E5EBEB77D0ECCDC2EA07634A81595F31E88B85E8B4B54'; Write-Host '=== READ / EVIDENCE ==='; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $v36)){throw 'v3.6 candidate missing'}; $actual=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $v36 -Algorithm SHA256).Hash; Write-Host ('V36_SHA256='+$actual); if($actual -ne $expected){throw 'v3.6 SHA256 mismatch'}; $tok=$null;$err=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($v36,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null; Write-Host ('V36_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($err).Count); if(@($err).Count -ne 0){throw 'v3.6 syntax check failed'}; $self=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId='+$PID) -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host ('CURRENT_RUNNER_PID='+$PID); Write-Host ('CURRENT_RUNNER_COMMANDLINE='+$self.CommandLine); $alreadyV36=($self.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*'); Write-Host ('CURRENT_RUNNER_IS_V36='+$alreadyV36); Write-Host '=== CONCLUSION ==='; if($alreadyV36){Write-Host 'HANDOVER_ALREADY_COMPLETE=TRUE'; Set-Content -LiteralPath ($root+'/chapter-025-v36-handover.txt') -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('CHAPTER_025_RESULT=ALREADY_V36',('CURRENT_PID='+$PID),('COMMANDLINE='+$self.CommandLine),('V36_SHA256='+$actual)); Write-Host 'ONE_LOGICAL_CHANGE=NONE_REQUIRED'}else{Write-Host 'HANDOVER_REQUIRED=TRUE'; Write-Host '=== ONE LOGICAL CHANGE ==='; $currentPid=[int]$PID; $taskUrl='https://api.github.com/repos/3en4all/3en-command-runner/contents/task.json?ref=main'; $helperLines=[string[]]@('$ErrorActionPreference=''Continue''',('$oldRunnerPid='+$currentPid),'$root=''C:/3EN-Agent''','$stateFile=$root+''/3en-agent.state.json''','$v36=$root+''/3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1''','$report=$root+''/chapter-025-v36-handover.txt''',('$taskUrl='''+$taskUrl+''''),'function WriteReport([string]$text){Add-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value ((Get-Date -Format ''yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss'')+'' ''+$text)}','Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value ''=== CHAPTER 025 RUNTIME-AWARE HANDOVER ===''','WriteReport (''CAPTURED_CURRENT_RUNNER_PID=''+$oldRunnerPid)','$deadline=(Get-Date).AddSeconds(120)','$finalized=$false','while((Get-Date)-lt $deadline){try{if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $stateFile){$state=Get-Content -LiteralPath $stateFile -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($state.lastExecutedId -eq ''2026-09-09-025''){$finalized=$true;WriteReport ''STATE_FINALIZED=TRUE'';break}}}catch{WriteReport (''STATE_READ_RETRY=''+$_.Exception.Message)};Start-Sleep -Seconds 2}','if(-not $finalized){WriteReport ''HANDOVER_RESULT=ABORT_STATE_TIMEOUT'';exit 22}','try{$newRunner=Start-Process -FilePath ''powershell.exe'' -ArgumentList @(''-NoProfile'',''-ExecutionPolicy'',''Bypass'',''-File'',$v36,''-TaskUrl'',$taskUrl) -PassThru;WriteReport (''V36_START_PID=''+$newRunner.Id)}catch{WriteReport (''HANDOVER_RESULT=FAIL_START ''+$_.Exception.Message);exit 23}','Start-Sleep -Seconds 8','$v36Procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like ''*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*''})','WriteReport (''V36_PROCESS_COUNT=''+$v36Procs.Count)','if($v36Procs.Count -lt 1){WriteReport ''HANDOVER_RESULT=FAIL_V36_NOT_RUNNING'';exit 24}','try{Stop-Process -Id $oldRunnerPid -Force -ErrorAction Stop;WriteReport ''OLD_RUNNER_STOPPED=TRUE''}catch{WriteReport (''OLD_RUNNER_STOP_ERROR=''+$_.Exception.Message)}','Start-Sleep -Seconds 3','$oldLeft=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.ProcessId -eq $oldRunnerPid})','$newLeft=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like ''*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*''})','WriteReport (''FINAL_OLD_RUNNER_PRESENT=''+($oldLeft.Count -gt 0))','WriteReport (''FINAL_V36_PROCESS_COUNT=''+$newLeft.Count)','if(($oldLeft.Count -eq 0)-and($newLeft.Count -ge 1)){WriteReport ''HANDOVER_RESULT=PASS'';exit 0}else{WriteReport ''HANDOVER_RESULT=FAIL_FINAL_STATE'';exit 25}'); Set-Content -LiteralPath $helper -Value $helperLines -Encoding UTF8; $ht=$null;$he=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$ht,[ref]$he)|Out-Null; Write-Host ('HELPER_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($he).Count); if(@($he).Count -ne 0){throw 'Generated helper syntax invalid'}; $helperProc=Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$helper) -PassThru; Write-Host ('HANDOVER_HELPER_PID='+$helperProc.Id); Write-Host 'HANDOVER_HELPER_ARMED=TRUE'}
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='C:/3EN-Agent'; $self=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter ('ProcessId='+$PID) -ErrorAction Stop; $alreadyV36=($self.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1*'); if($alreadyV36){Write-Host 'CHAPTER_025_TEST=PASS_ALREADY_V36'; Write-Host ('ACTIVE_CURRENT_PID='+$PID)}else{$helper=$root+'/switch-to-v36-025.ps1'; if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $helper)){throw 'handover helper missing'}; $tok=$null;$err=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null; Write-Host ('HELPER_SYNTAX_ERROR_COUNT='+@($err).Count); if(@($err).Count -ne 0){throw 'handover helper syntax invalid'}; $armed=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*switch-to-v36-025.ps1*'}); Write-Host ('HANDOVER_HELPER_PROCESS_COUNT='+$armed.Count); if($armed.Count -lt 1){throw 'handover helper is not running'}; Write-Host 'CHAPTER_025_PRE_FINALIZE_TEST=PASS'}; Write-Host 'RUNTIME_AWARE_HANDOVER_LOGIC=PASS'
rollback: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Host 'No destructive rollback needed before delayed handover. The actual current runner PID is stopped only after v3.6 is verified running. Backup is under C:/3EN-Agent/backups/025.'
